model.title: Protect College Sports Act of 2026
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would protect college athletes' rights to earn money from their names, images, and likenesses by prohibiting schools from restricting these deals, while requiring athletes to disclose compensation above $600 and capping agent fees at 5%. It would also grant athletes one penalty-free transfer, restrict coaches from switching teams mid-season, establish limits on how schools can compensate athletes to avoid circumventing revenue-sharing rules, and allow schools and conferences to jointly sell sports broadcasting rights under limited antitrust protections.
